mekayis.metin: (لَوَطَ) اللَّامُ وَالْوَاوُ وَالطَّاءُ كَلِمَةٌ تَدُلُّ عَلَى اللُّصُوقِ. يُقَالُ: لَاطَ الشَّيْءُ بِقَلْبِي، إِذَا لَصِقَ. وَفِي بَعْضِ الْحَدِيثِ: «الْوَلَدُ أَلْوَطُ بِالْقَلْبِ» ، أَيْ أَلْصَقَ. وَيَقُولُونَ: هَذَا أَمْرٌ لَا يَلْتَاطُ بِصَفَرِي، أَيْ لَا يَلْصَقُ بِقَلْبِي. وَلُطْتُ الْحَوْضَ لَوْطًا، إِذَا مَدَرْتَهُ بِالطِّينِ.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: لُوطِيّ • (lūṭiyy) (feminine لُوطِيَّة (lūṭiyya), masculine plural لُوطِيُّون (lūṭiyyūn), feminine plural لُوطِيَّات (lūṭiyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: لُوط (lūṭ, “Lot”) + ـِيّ (-iyy), with an association with the figure's people instead of the figure himself. More at لَاطَ (lāṭa).
لُوط (lūṭ, “Lot”) + ـِيّ (-iyy), with an association with the figure's people instead of the figure himself. More at لَاطَ (lāṭa).
g: a homosexual, a sodomite; a pederast

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From لَاطَ (lāṭa, “to sodomize”), a sense derived from Lot لُوط (lūṭ); see Islamic view of Lot and Sodom and Gomorrah.
Borrowed from Hebrew לוֹט (lot). Related to native Arabic root ل و ط (l w ṭ), related to sticking or adhering. See لاط (lāṭ).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: لَاطَ • (lāṭa) I (non-past يَلُوطُ (yalūṭu), verbal noun لَوْط (lawṭ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: The sense of "anal sex" derives directly from لُوط (lūṭ, “Lot”), with the meaning of "to do as Lot's people did", and was subsequently leveled to the root by analogy. For formation, compare English sodomize.
